newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens ANL awards 8,000t Indonesia freigHT.
newsitem.headline: Siemens ANL awards 8,000t Indonesia freigHT.

text.p: Siemens AG Industrial & Building Systems (ANL) said it has awarded an 8,000 tonne freight contract to German forwarder Hansa Meyer Transport GmbH.

Steffen Rudkowsky, Siemens ANL traffic and shipping manager, said the contract was for the transport of 6,000 tonnes of electrical systems and 2,000 tonnes of other freight from Germany to a paper factory on Sumatra, Indonesia.
"Hansa Meyer in Bremen has won the tender for the forwarding part," he told Reuters in an interview.
While the bulk of the freight would be transported by sea, Siemens ANL would also have a direct agreement with Lufthansa Cargo for airfreight capacity during the project.
This meant Siemens ANL, Hansa Meyer and its air cargo partner Senator Airfreight would jointly discuss airfreight needs with Lufthansa over the course of the project, Rudkowsky explained.
Siemens ANL had already agreed a fixed, net rate with Lufthansa for any air cargo space used in the project, he noted.
"I will give the (airline) rate to the forwarder. Alongside the sum which he gets from us for his services, he gets our net rate and not (one) with commission," the Siemens manager said.
